verdict.rationale: Docusign clearly documents sending documents for e-signature ("Send, sign and manage all your agreements", the eSignature REST API and the official Node client). Multi-recipient routing is only implied, by "configurable workflows" and delegated signing. Community users confirm that envelope sending and embedded signing work in practice. missing for 10: explicit evidence of multiple recipients with sequential/parallel routing order, explicit legally binding/compliance claims, hands-on corroboration of routing flows.
